CREATE TABLE "public"."attendance_marks" (
  "cancelled_at" timestamptz,
  "dispute_reason" text,
  "dispute_requested_at" timestamptz,
  "dispute_resolved_at" timestamptz,
  "dispute_resolved_by_account_id" uuid,
  "dispute_status" text DEFAULT 'none' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "marked_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "marked_by_kind" text NOT NULL,
  "marked_by_member_id" uuid,
  "marked_by_staff_account_id" uuid,
  "member_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "reservation_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "session_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "attendance_marks_dispute_status_check_465c5334" CHECK ("dispute_status" IN ('none', 'requested', 'accepted', 'rejected')),
  CONSTRAINT "attendance_marks_marked_by_kind_check_8d77fa61" CHECK ("marked_by_kind" IN ('member', 'instructor', 'owner')),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_attendance_dispute_requested_8d71c568" CHECK ((dispute_status = 'none') = (dispute_requested_at IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_attendance_dispute_resolved_e8bdf526" CHECK ((dispute_status IN ('accepted', 'rejected')) = (dispute_resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND dispute_resolved_by_account_id IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_attendance_dispute_staff_only_71548a57" CHECK (dispute_status = 'none' OR marked_by_kind <> 'member'),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_attendance_marker_8dca703c" CHECK ((marked_by_kind = 'member' AND marked_by_member_id IS NOT NULL AND marked_by_staff_account_id IS NULL) OR (marked_by_kind <> 'member' AND marked_by_staff_account_id IS NOT NULL AND marked_by_member_id IS NULL))
)
